solution.title: Configuration Manager Cloud Management Gateway (CMG) Setup & Operations

products.name: Configuration Manager Cloud Management Gateway (CMG) Setup & Operations — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up a Configuration Manager Cloud Management Gateway (CMG) so you can manage internet-based Windows clients securely — policy, software updates, and inventory with no VPN and no inbound firewall holes. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Manage internet-based Windows clients from Configuration Manager — without a VPN

Your laptops left the building and never came back. Remote and hybrid Windows devices that used to sit on the LAN now rarely touch the corporate network, so Configuration Manager can't reach them: policy goes stale, software updates stall, inventory goes dark, and you can't tell a healthy device from a dead one. A Cloud Management Gateway (CMG) fixes that — an Azure-hosted front door that lets Configuration Manager manage internet-based clients securely, with no VPN and no inbound firewall holes.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how a CMG works, the CMG + cloud management point design, token vs. PKI authentication, and where it fits alongside co-management with Intune.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (supported Configuration Manager current branch, an Azure subscription, Entra ID app registrations, the CMG server authentication certificate, client authentication model, e-HTTP/enhanced HTTP or PKI, boundary and content design) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: Azure services onboarding, create the CMG cloud service, add the CMG connection point, enable the management point and software update point for CMG traffic, configure clients for cloud management, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — environment-readiness discovery, CMG/client connectivity validation, an internet-client health and reach report, safe remediation of misconfigured clients, and a cloud-management settings helper.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Internet-based Windows clients fully manageable from Configuration Manager — receiving policy, software updates, and inventory over a secure Azure front door — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CMG-Discovery.ps1 — Read-only environment-readiness discovery for a Configuration Manager
    • CMG-Remediation.ps1 — Safe remediation of a misconfigured Configuration Manager client so it can
    • CMG-Report.ps1 — Read-only internet-client health and reach report for a Configuration Manager
    • CMG-Set-CloudManagementTargeting.ps1 — Cloud-management settings helper. Scopes the
    • CMG-Validation.ps1 — Read-only validation of CMG public endpoint, certificate, and a client's

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
